summary: TEST-DESIGNER (WF-02 Step 3) produced the SPT-02/SPT-03/SPT-04 test suite for the schema-per-tenant migration: three test specs (tests/specs/SPT-02.md, SPT-03.md, SPT-04.md), a new 16-test integration binary (tests/integration/spt02_03_04_schema_tenant_migration_test.zig) covering all 16 MUST acceptance criteria (SPT-02: 6, SPT-03: 5, SPT-04: 5), the SPT-04 per-test schema provision/drop helpers in tests/integration/helpers.zig (provisionTestTenantSchema/dropTestTenantSchema), and build.zig wiring (narrow step test-integration-spt + barrier-chained umbrella run, ISS-0106 pattern). Verified against the live bpm_test DB (port 5434): 10/16 tests PASS. The remaining 6 tests (TC-SPT-02-02, TC-SPT-03-02/03/04/05, TC-SPT-04-04) are CORRECT but BLOCKED by a pre-existing production defect: fresh tenant-schema provisioning fails because migration 020_obs03_audit_entries.sql's unqualified CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bpm_audit_resource_info (OUT resource_id UUID) resolves public's same-signature TEXT-typed copy (GBL-120/GBL-121) across search_path and PostgreSQL rejects the OUT-type change ('cannot change return type of existing function'). This also breaks the already-released SPT-01 provisioning tests. Filed as GitHub issue #812 + docs/issues/ISS-0715.json (BLOCKER, root cause + candidate fix). Migration 020 is BACKEND-DEV scope (AGENT_SYSTEM.md §3), so TEST-DESIGNER did not modify it. lint_test_isolation.py (new files + full tests/integration) exit 0; lint_handoffs.py exit 0 (0 BLOCKER/MAJOR).

issues_found.description: ISS-0715 / GitHub #812: fresh tenant-schema provisioning fails — migration 020_obs03_audit_entries.sql's unqualified CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bpm_audit_resource_info (OUT resource_id UUID) conflicts with public's TEXT-typed same-signature copy (GBL-120/GBL-121) across search_path; PostgreSQL rejects with 'cannot change return type of existing function'. Blocks 6 of 16 SPT tests + the released SPT-01 provisioning tests. Pre-existing (regression since GBL-121), not introduced by this run. Candidate fix (BACKEND-DEV): schema-aware DROP-then-CREATE in 020 (EXECUTE format('DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS %I.bpm_audit_resource_info(text,jsonb,jsonb)', current_schema())) mirroring the 1139/GBL-120 pattern. ORCH to create an ADHOC for BACKEND-DEV.

SPT-04 AC1 broad suite rework (the ~118 tests/integration/ files that still carry legacy row-based tenancy fixtures — adp02/adp03/env02/03/05/par06/pin01/prm01/svc04 etc.) is NOT completed in this handoff. Those files still pass at runtime (tenant_default retains the tenant_id columns, bpm_effective_tenant_id() and set_config('bpm.tenant_id') still function against the tenant schema), but they remain on the legacy model. This handoff's SPT suite introduces the schema-isolated pattern (provisionTestTenantSchema/dropTestTenantSchema) and covers the 16 ACs; the broader rework is a follow-up SPT batch (consistent with SECURITY-REVIEWER Step 2c notes).

next_steps: ORCH: create ADHOC/BACKEND-DEV handoff for ISS-0715 (GitHub #812) — fix migration 020 bpm_audit_resource_info schema-aware DROP-then-CREATE so fresh tenant provisioning works.
Route this handoff to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (WF-02 Step 3b) — specs (16 cases) match implemented test count (16 blocks), no SkipZigTest, fixtures isolated, lint clean.
After ISS-0715 lands, re-run zig build test-integration-spt — all 16 tests should pass; then TEST-RUNNER (Step 5) runs the SPT suite under the umbrella.
